svg.title: What Home shows under Sample reports
svg.desc: Home checks four cases in order. If branding is on and saved branding cards exist, it shows those cards. Otherwise, if the samples folder set in System configuration exists and holds reports the user can read, it shows the five most recently modified reports placed directly in that folder, with View all opening the folder. Otherwise, on an installation upgraded from before 10.02 that still has the old hidden samples, it shows the old sample list without View all. Otherwise the section is hidden. Each report card's cover is the uploaded cover if an administrator set one, else an automatic screenshot for dashboards, else a placeholder.
svg.text: Which list Home shows (first match wins)
1. Branding is on and has saved cards
Shows those cards, as before 10.02. Only installations that saved
cards earlier have them. Branding › Home › Move to the samples folder
2. The samples folder has reports the user can read
Folder: System configuration › Home page › Samples folder (/public/Samples)
Shows the 5 most recently modified reports placed directly in it
(dashboards, paginated reports, .prpt; subfolders are not read).
View all opens the folder. Each user sees only reports they can read.
3. Upgraded installation without that folder
Shows the same five samples as before the upgrade, without View all.
Point the setting at a folder of your own to switch.
4. Otherwise: no Sample reports section
no cards
